statement: Discard the capital-neutral parallel Burn-in design and close this hardware-expansion branch under the unchanged 230,000 capital and locked service boundary. The only feasible offset removes two utility plants; Run 108 proves that trade can clear nominal back-end WIP, but the immutable review fails preserve-on-time-service under facility interruption (5 on-time lots versus the required 9) and nominal operation already loses one on-time lot. The next bounded intervention should stay on the incumbent rack and test release or operating timing against the exact tail, not add another rack or weaken utility resilience.
